items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I asked Jimmy Garrison, his bass player, “What are you guys doing with this new thing with McCoy Tyner and everything.”

ctx.x: While the Civil Rights movement was getting going, and I guess there was a certain amount of black power type things?

Yeah, those things were happening, yeah, a little bit. I remember being down at the Village Vanguard and thinking, that was me, I mean knew me, John Coltrane, and I was to him about reeds backstage and he was trying different reeds, this doesn’t work, that doesn’t work, and I asked Jimmy Garrison, his bass player, “What are you guys doing with this new thing with McCoy Tyner and everything.” And all he would tell me is “We’re just playing. I mean we’re just doing things we do.” I mean there wasn’t any secret that…
Either he didn’t want to give away any secrets, or maybe they were just doing that.
